# Karthik Sarvan

> Karthik Sarvan (also indexed as Sarvan Karthik) is a Linux graphics & kernel
> engineer and systems developer based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India.
> He contributes upstream to Mesa 3D (Vulkan/OpenGL, NIR compiler passes, Lavapipe,
> and Zink), researches the Linux Direct Rendering Manager (DRM) and Kernel
> Mode Setting (KMS) subsystem, and is the lead architect and maintainer of
> Mimic (mimic.aegiondynamic.com), an open-source hardware emulation framework.

This is the canonical portfolio and briefing for Karthik Sarvan.

## Key Facts

- Full name: Karthik Sarvan
- Known as: Sarvan Karthik, K. Sarvan, karthik-sarvan
- Primary Focus: Linux Graphics, Mesa 3D Driver Development, Linux Kernel DRM/KMS, Bare-Metal C & Rust
- Upstream GitLab: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/karthik-sarvan
- Upstream GitHub: https://github.com/Karthik-Sarvan (over 2,740+ commits in 2026)
- Hardware Emulation: https://mimic.aegiondynamic.com
- Production Portfolio: https://karthik.qzz.io/
- Contact: karthiks1mail@gmail.com

## Selected Upstream Contributions & Work

- Mesa 3D (MR !45614): Lavapipe Vulkan pipeline cache header size calculation.
- Zink (OpenGL over Vulkan): Submits-per-frame HUD query profiling instrumentation.
- NIR: Intermediate representation passes, SPIR-V lowering, and compiler SSA optimization.
- Linux DRM/KMS: GEM buffer management, atomic modesetting commits, and wp_linux_drm_syncobj_v1 timeline fences.
- Mimic: Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test harness proxying physical I2C/SPI sensors on bare-metal STM32 microcontrollers.
